text:
incident-bot: [5407778888] Severity: S2 — sudden p99 latency spike on inference gateway (/v1/stream, /v1/completions). p95 ~ 320ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~ 3.8s. Streaming stalls observed, client-side timeouts increased. Potential upstream: auth/config-store errors; rate-limit bursts seen.

cheng: picking this up — I'm oncall. seeing alerts from gateway and streaming tail dashboards. good to confirm impact window.

alex: digging logs now. stack traces show repeated 503s from config-store and 429s from token-store cache. example from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:01:02Z INFO route=/v1/stream req_id=abc123 upstream=config-fetch status=503 retries=2 latency_ms=1250
2026-03-15T12:02:11Z WARN tokenstore get user_id=U123 error=rate_limited backoff=50ms
```

maria: I can take live mitigation. handoff to @maria. alex — can you confirm which feature flags/config keys are hot?

alex: looks like 'rich_context_v2' and 'session_prefetch' config fetches spike per new session init. hotkey fanout to config-store from many gateways. patterns: many small requests with large fanout.

priya: telemetry shows KV cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 48% in the last 4m for config-store. means more synchronous fetches. that correlates with streaming tail stalls since model runtime waits for route config.

sam: customer impact: we've observed ~1.7% of streaming requests exceed customer SLO (99.9%) in the last 6 minutes. a few enterprise customers on dedicated capacity reported degraded streaming quality.

cheng: immediate mitigations we should try (short list):
- throttle/limit config-store fanout at gateway (soft-limit per-session)
- enable fallback cached config (serve stale for 30s)
- disable heavy feature flag 'rich_context_v2' canary for global traffic
- route new sessions to secondary auth region if token-store overloaded

maria: doing steps in order. starting with feature flag rollback and enabling stale-config fallback. will post commands.

maria: toggling feature flag to off for global by API (will keep a canary window 2m then full).
```bash
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"rich_context_v2","state":"off","reason":"mitigation - configstore overload"}'
```

omment-ops: @deploy-bot will apply the stale-config fallback patch to gateway config.

deploy-bot: deploy started for gateway-stale-config. CI green. rolling to region us-west-2 (10 pods). ETA ~90s. :rocket:

alex: also increasing token-store per-ip request window to reduce 429s for now. command to bump RPM temporarily:
```json
POST /admin/rate_limit {"token_store_rpm": 1200}
```

priya: monitoring dashboards — config-store request rate down ~60% after flag toggle and fallback enabling. KV hit rate recovering to ~78% in 45s. streaming p99 trending down from 3.8s -> 920ms.

cheng: good. keep watch for 5m. please capture exact windows for postmortem. sam — can you draft a short customer impact note for statuspage? include affected endpoints and estimated duration.

sam: drafted: "We observed elevated latency affecting streaming APIs between 12:01-12:08 UTC due to config-service backpressure. Most customers saw transient increases in latency; small subset on streaming SLOs experienced degradation. Mitigation applied and traffic stabilized by 12:08 UTC." Can post if no objections.

maria: one more precaution: will enable routing fallback to model-variant smaller-context for sessions where config fetch doesn't return in 300ms (non-blocking mode). implementing in gateway config now.

alex: note — there were a few config-store pods OOMKILLed around the spike window. logs: "OOMKilled: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError". ops team should check heap/GC settings.

priya: capturing traces for tail latencies. attaching p99 traces to the incident channel. early look shows tokencache misses cause synchronous auth->config fetch chain adding ~600-900ms.

cheng: if we stabilize and p99 < 1s for 5m, we'll downgrade to S3 and start root-cause. keep live mitigation open for 30m.

oncall-rotator: handoff planned to @cheng -> @maria in 15m if stable. please update this thread when you hand off.

maria: handing off to @maria (live mitigations active). leaving a note: feature flag off, stale-config fallback enabled, token-store RPM bumped, model-variant fallback in place, gateway roll to apply patch in flight.

alex: root-cause suspects: config-store memory pressure + token-store rate-limit misconfiguration causing cascading sync waits. next steps for RCA: heap dump from config pods, review token-store rate windowing logic, evaluate config pre-warming for heavy feature flags.

sam: posted statuspage update. customers on dedicated plans notified via account reps.

priya: final observables: p95 back to ~210ms within 2m, p99 ~760ms and decaying. will continue to monitor for 30m.

cheng: closing live mitigation section. keeping incident open for RCA. tagging this for postmortem. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
